Port the context-held Log (bump/logged/reset over a MutableArray, installed with `with context Log`) as a coroutine probe, as destructure-once-nested-once's port in collections.bot (a generator source) or values.bot's probe (`fn probe(id, v): yield id; v`, the body drives the coroutine and collects the ids): a body cannot require a context.
